title.narrative: Construction of Five Climate Resilient Bridges in Mymensingh Division, Bangladesh

description.narrative:
The Project Development Objective (PDO) is to improve the socio-economic conditions of people living in the project’s zone of influence by upgrading the level of service on the Sunamganj – Jamalpur Border Road (Z-2834) and Shymganj – Durgapur Border Road (Z-3704) through the construction of 5 climate resilient bridges to improve connectivity in Mymensingh Division. This objective is directly relevant to the problem statement, i.e. the poor road connectivity along the Z-2834 and Z-3704, hinders the socio-economic development of the region. The objective is also in line with the country's development objectives and targets for the road transport sub-sector.
